newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Bear Stearns details Sun upgrade.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Bear Stearns details Sun upgrade.

text.p: -- Bear Stearns analyst Andrew Neff said he upgraded Sun Microsystems Inc to buy from attractive, citing the potential for positive earnings surprises in the near term.
-- Left fiscal 1997 earnings estimate at $1.80 per share and 1998 at $2.20 per share but said the outlook "could be conservative for fiscal 1998 in particular."
-- Said early in fiscal Q3, Sun appears "on track" for expectations of $0.47 per share in the full quarter.
-- Cited Sun's new product cycle, broader customer base and expectations of share repurchases all as positives.
